definitions.explanation: Leaves that have changed color in autumn, especially red and yellow.
A tree known for its beautiful autumn colors (Acer palmatum).

examples.english: I went to Kyoto to see the autumn leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紅葉|もみじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: This year's autumn foliage is beautiful.
I planted a Japanese maple in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紅葉|もみじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The autumn leaves in Kyoto are beautiful.
I planted a maple tree in the garden.
I made pressed flowers from maple leaves.

notes:
The kanji {紅葉|もみじ} has two readings with different nuances:
- もみじ: autumn leaves (concrete), or the Japanese maple tree
- ⟦こうよう→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧: the phenomenon of leaves changing color in autumn

CULTURE:
⟦{紅葉狩|もみじが}り→紅葉狩り：05588_momijigari⟧ (autumn leaf viewing) is a beloved seasonal activity, similar to ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧ (cherry blossom viewing) in spring. Peak season is typically November.

FAMOUS VIEWING SPOTS:
- ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧: temples surrounded by red maples
- ⟦{日光|にっこう}→日光：03515_nikkou⟧: Nikko in Tochigi Prefecture
- ⟦{嵐山|あらしやま}→嵐山：noentry⟧: western Kyoto

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紅葉|もみじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go see autumn leaves
- {紅葉|もみじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧: famous autumn foliage spots
- {紅葉|もみじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{色|いろ}づく→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧: the leaves change color

NOTE:
もみじ can also refer specifically to the Japanese maple tree (⟦カエデ→楓：04375_kaede⟧), which has distinctively shaped leaves often used as a design motif.
